marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major US semiconductor equipment manufacturers reported strong order backlogs driven by hyperscaler AI capex, while leading cloud providers reaffirmed elevated data center spending for H2.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained capital expenditure from big tech continues to anchor earnings support for the broader US hardware and chip supply chain, upholding tech index momentum.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential tightening of cross-border technology export controls and supply bottlenecks in advanced packaging capacity.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Chinese Internet Platforms
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index saw strong inflows after major e-commerce and cloud operators reported higher-than-expected operating margins due to AI-driven ad efficiency and disciplined cost control.
marketLayer.inference: Margin expansion and monetization of enterprise AI tools are beginning to offset cautious consumer sentiment, aiding valuation recovery for HK-listed Chinese internet majors.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of domestic macro consumption recovery and competitive price wars in retail and local services segments.

marketLayer.title: US Macro Policy & Interest Rate Expectations
marketLayer.fact: US inflation indicators showed steady deceleration alongside moderate wage growth, keeping market consensus aligned toward upcoming Federal Reserve rate cuts.
marketLayer.inference: A easing yield environment reduces global discount rates, providing equity valuation tailwinds for high-growth sectors across both US and HK equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential stickiness in services inflation or hawkish messaging from upcoming FOMC policy statements.

marketLayer.title: HK & China Electric Vehicles (EV)
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese EV makers listed in Hong Kong reported record monthly export volumes alongside expanded distribution deals across European and Middle Eastern markets.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas market expansion is becoming a critical revenue engine to hedge against intense domestic price competition in mainland China.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving foreign trade policies, anti-subsidy duties, and localized regulatory hurdles in key export destinations.
